articles.title: Valiance Solutions Launches Tender Intelligence, an Enterprise SaaS for Government Procurement
articles.description: New Delhi [India], August 11: Across government offices in India, a familiar scene plays out every day. A tender closes, and bids begin to arrive, sometimes dozens, often hundreds. Each submission is a stack of documents running into hundreds of pages, varying in format, structure, and completeness. Procurement officers are tasked with reviewing every page, verifying qualifications, evaluating compliance, and producing a comparative assessment that must stand up to audits, regulatory scrutiny, and RTI queries, often years later. This is not an exception. It is the operational reality of public procurement at scale.
